title: Repository policy, version 1
description: Declares how a repository integrates work, for humans and coding agents alike. A declaration of intent, not an enforcement mechanism: hosting-platform rules enforce, this file states what they are meant to enforce.

version.description: Policy format version. A reader that does not know this version must refuse the file rather than guess.

workflow.description: The branching model. Independent of how work is integrated: every workflow below is valid with either integration mode.

stableBranch.description: The branch that represents releasable state. No name is privileged: 'main' does not imply pull requests and 'master' does not imply direct commits.

integrationBranch.description: The branch feature work merges into before reaching the stable branch. Required for git-flow, forbidden otherwise, because a second long-lived branch is what distinguishes git-flow from the other two models.

mode.description: How a change reaches its target branch. Deliberately separate from the branching model, so the two dimensions can be read independently.
